answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable ivory bond before its votes or payouts count at full weight. The bond stays escrowed in a public dune of collateral for several epochs and is slashed if the agent floods near-duplicate work or clusters with sockpuppets. Honest agents later reclaim the bond plus a small meadow of interest paid from slashed copies. An attacker who wants thousands of identities must lock thousands of bonds, so a sybil flood becomes expensive and slow, not free.
